text:
Maya Chen: Pushed a fresh batch of web copy variants for the site: hero, product-mode module (hosted / dedicated / private), and demo/signup flows. Can we quick-iterate?
Oliver Park: Skimming now. Is there a primary KPI we should optimize copy for (demo signups vs trial starts)?
Maya Chen: Priority order: demo signups (sales handoff) > self-serve trial > webinar signups. Demo leads get routed to AE for Private/Dedicated prospects.
Sam R: Love the shorter hero variants. One note: language around "predictable throughput" reads a bit jargony for the hero. Maybe swap to "consistent performance you can rely on"?
Priya Kaur: Agreed with Sam. Also for inbound routing, propose: separate CTAs — "Request demo" (AE route) and "Start free trial" (self-serve). Use checkbox in form: "I need dedicated capacity / private deployment" to flag AE.
Jordan: For webinar promotion, we should surface a benchmark tease: "See real latency & cost comparisons in our live demo." Short and curiosity-driving. Also add a landing anchor that jumps to benchmarks section.
Luis: Routing logic for leads: if form selects "private/dedicated" OR company size >200 -> tag as enterprise -> route to AE queue. Else go to self-serve nurture. I'll add the Zapier rule. :gear:
Maya Chen: Nice. For hero CTAs I drafted 3 variants: A) "Powerful LLM inference, predictable costs" B) "Fast, reliable model serving for production" C) "Ship LLM features with predictable performance" Which one feels clearest?
Oliver Park: Leaning C for product-led clarity, but shorten: "Ship LLM features with predictable performance."
Sam R: Suggest microcopy under CTA: "Hosted API for quick start • Dedicated for scale • Private for compliance" — short bullets inline.
Priya Kaur: Webinar pitch line drafted: "Join our live benchmark: hosted vs dedicated vs private — see latency, cost, and routing tradeoffs." Keep it under 100 chars.
Maya Chen: Added a small code snippet for the demo signup redirect in the page JS — can we verify?
Maya Chen: ```
// simple form handler
if (formData.needsAE || formData.companySize > 200) {
  routeTo('ae_queue', {tag: 'enterprise', source: 'site-hero'});
} else {
  routeTo('nurture', {source: 'site-hero'});
}
```
Jordan: Looks good. Can we also add UTM tracking: utm_medium=web, utm_campaign=launch_q2, utm_content=hero_variant_C
Luis: I'll wire the routing + UTM in the Zap. Also will add rule to split webinar registrants into "Benchmarks" and "Use-case" buckets based on selected interest.
Maya Chen: Timeline: please review copy comments by EOD today. We'll lock hero + CTA by tomorrow morning to feed launch posts and webinar emails.
Sam R: Quick A/B plan: run hero C vs trimmed B for 1 week, measure demo CTA CTR and demo form completions.
Priya Kaur: I'll draft the webinar email copy and a short social post with the benchmark tease. Posting schedule: 3 social pushes, 1 email, 1 webinar reminder.
launch-bot: Scheduled reminder set for 2024-05-02 10:00 UTC — "Lock site copy for launch" :bell:
Maya Chen: Thanks team — I'll make changes and ping when updates are live. :raised_hands:
